Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zucsv 0.1.0

First release.

  • read_csv() reads a local delimited file into a base R data.frame, using a bundled subset of the zsv C parser. No R package dependencies.

  • Handles quoted fields, embedded delimiters and newlines, escaped quotes, LF and CRLF, a missing final terminator, and a UTF-8 BOM.

  • Infers logical, integer, double and character column types, or takes them from col_types. A value that will not convert to a forced type is an error naming the row, column and value, never a silent NA.

  • header, delimiter and na control the header row, the field delimiter (any single ASCII byte) and which cell values read as missing.

  • Documented, tested behavior that is easy to get wrong elsewhere: blank lines are skipped everywhere, every record must have the same width, column names are preserved exactly including duplicates, invalid UTF-8 and embedded NULs are errors where they occur, and nothing is whitespace trimmed.

  • Large reads are interruptible, and the file handle and parser are released on errors and interrupts alike.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
